forum.title: STM32U3C5 - SMPS: Is an inductor needed for each VDD11?
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello,

I recommend to refer to the [AN6011](https://www.st.com/resource/en/application_note/an6011-getting-started-with-stm32u3-mcu-hardware-development-stmicroelectronics.pdf) "*Getting started with STM32U3 MCU hardware development*" / *Section 8 Reference design:*

![mALLEm_0-1777904800208.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/6cbe14dd-32a3-3d42-9343-1998d1d3e0e7.png "mALLEm_0-1777904800208.png")

Hope that helps.

PS: I'll escalate internally to remove this confusion from the datasheet. Internal ticket for follow-up: ***CDM0062340.***
forum.content_text:
Hello,

I am working on a design incorporating the STM32U3C5CIU6Q in SMPS mode. This package includes two VDD11 pins. I am having trouble interpreting the datasheet when it comes to the number of inductors I will need. This note under **Figure 24** in the datasheet is clear that each pin will need a capacitor to VSSSMPS, but it seems like it could also imply that each VDD11 pin requires its own inductor between VLXSMPS.

![AQB_0-1777900009211.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/2b3e68c7-a683-c149-2489-6a46bb237fb8.png "AQB_0-1777900009211.png")

The power supply scheme (with SMPS) is also not clear to me:

![AQB_2-1777900236726.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/2a741fc8-20d1-acd0-8b8f-224200c897ef.png "AQB_2-1777900236726.png")

This section seems more like it is expecting a single inductor:

![AQB_3-1777900508633.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/6b48f021-3ae6-041a-a872-ed445df38b73.png "AQB_3-1777900508633.png")

Am I okay to use a single inductor between the VLXSMPS pin and VD11 node, with each VD11 pin having its own capacitors, or should I treat each VD11 as a separate loop with its own inductor as well?

Thanks for any help!
